CustomField.label: Allow Run In Production
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Controls whether PrivacyGuard may run masking operations in a production org. Keep disabled unless production execution has been explicitly approved and governed.
CustomField.description: Leave false. The framework blocks all masking/deletion jobs outside of Sandboxes by default. Only enable this with deliberate, documented sign-off - it defeats the core safety net of this tool.
